basis: 1E (Rose daily work plan, 2026-11-07; first built as 1F on 2026-11-05): build, sign, verify and publish each flavor daily at 4 a.m. Pacific through its own entry point, builder and lifecycle, so one unavailable flavor never blocks another; manual dispatch stays. scripts/daily-release.py reads this file.
activation: The schedule is in .github/workflows/daily-release.yml and does nothing while every lane is disabled. Enabling a lane is its own reviewed change here, approved by that lane's owner and Chief; the lane's first scheduled run then builds and publishes main at the next window.

window.note: 1E: 4 a.m. Pacific in America/Los_Angeles, so the local time survives daylight-saving changes. The workflow's crons are exactly the UTC times that can be this local time (11:00 and 12:00 UTC); the dispatcher acts only on the one that is 04:00 local on that date.

lanes.name: frankel
lanes.lastGood: latest-beta promotes a new Beta Latest only after verification and the download check; a failed run publishes nothing new and older releases stay for rollback.

lanes.name: mustang
lanes.lastGood: mustang-ota-dedicated publishes the OTA before the channel metadata and never Latest; a failed run leaves mustang-stable on the last good build.
lanes.owner: Mustang Grok owner (dedicated route and builder; the shared-host os-release mustang-ota route is retired). Before enabling, the route must admit this automatic dispatch: its publication authority today requires automatic false.

lanes.name: yogi
lanes.lastGood: yogi-ota publishes the OTA first and yogi-stable last, never Latest; a failed run leaves the channel on the last good build.
lanes.owner: Yogi Grok owner (route and its dedicated builder). Before enabling, the route must admit this automatic dispatch: yogi-ota.yml is manual only today.
